code_review_findings.summary: [P2] Keep dismissing an owner notice from invalidating its pending peer delivery
code_review_findings.failure_scenario: The owner receives the persisted privacy notice and clicks Got it while the fixed peer refusal is awaiting review or retry. dismiss changes the incident to closed. PersonalActions.securityNotice requires status=open at prepare and commit, so an already allowed fixed refusal now fails with invalid_security_notice. Re-admitting the same source returns that same closed incident with no peer receipt, and every subsequent prepare fails; the input/peer-notice recovery cannot finish. Independently reproduced with actual Fastify dismiss, PersonalAgents and PersonalActions in /tmp/pa-static-review-616/r13-dismiss-receipt-probe.mts: dismissStatus=200, policyUnchanged=true, reviewedPeerCommitError=invalid_security_notice, retryReturnsClosedIncident=true, retryPrepareRejected=true. Separate UI acknowledgement from security-notice eligibility, or precisely retain the eligibility of a dismissed record while preserving block/misunderstanding revocation, actual owner receipt, exact fixed content and mandatory review. Add this interleaving to the regression tests; Got it is specified as display-only acknowledgement.

verification_findings.contract: Current and archive IM PA Scenario 简洁的隐私知情提醒: 知道了仅收起本次已看到的提醒，不改变披露策略; existing design requires actual owner receipt then reviewed fixed peer notice
verification_findings.actual: dismiss leaves policy revision, blocks and wake unchanged, but sets the incident closed. Existing fixed notice eligibility requires open. The owner acknowledgement can therefore cancel an already reviewed peer refusal and permanently prevent retry for the same admitted source.
verification_findings.action: Decouple acknowledgement display state from fixed-notice delivery eligibility; preserve exact fixed content, real owner receipt, binding/source checks and mandatory review. Cover owner acknowledgement after prepare/allow and before commit, followed by successful permitted retry. Do not broadly accept blocked or misunderstanding incidents.

closed_findings.resolution: dismiss changes only open to dedicated dismissed, without policy revision/block/wake. securityNotice accepts only open or dismissed with all original exact content, owner completed receipt, binding/conversation, source/audience and mandatory review constraints. closed/blocked are still rejected, and late dismiss cannot overwrite either. UI still filters only open, so acknowledged reminders disappear without canceling peer delivery.
